name: lk-agent-map
description: See and cap your subagents: cards with cost, tokens, context and progress, spawn caps with an override you approve, tree and team views, idle alerts and a Stop button.

stuckAfterMs.title: Idle alert after (ms)
stuckAfterMs.description: A running agent with no tool call and no model request for this long gets an idle note and one toast; 0 turns it off

maxConcurrent.title: Max subagents running at once
maxConcurrent.description: Running subagents at once, forks and teammates included; a spawn past it is refused. A whole number; 0 means no cap

maxPerTurn.title: Max subagents per turn
maxPerTurn.description: Spawns in one main-loop turn; forks and teammates don't count. A whole number; 0 means no cap

maxPerSession.title: Max subagents per session
maxPerSession.description: Spawns in the session. A whole number; 0 means no cap

warnAtPercent.title: Warn at (% of a cap)
warnAtPercent.description: From 1 to 100: once a cap reaches this share, the band shows near cap and one toast goes out

maxReturnedTokens.title: Max tokens subagent results add to the main context per session
maxReturnedTokens.description: Estimated as characters / 4. Past the warn share, one toast suggests /compact or a handoff; no spawn is refused for it. A whole number; 0 means no cap
